---
title: "Cars - Combined Inputs"
format: dashboard
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
df <- mpg
empty_plot <- function() {
  plotly_empty() |> layout(title = list(text = "No cars match these inputs.", y = 0.5))
}
```

# Plots

## {.sidebar}

```{r}
selectInput("var", "Color by", choices = c("class", "drv", "fl"))
checkboxGroupInput("drv", "Drive", choices = c("4", "f", "r"), selected = c("4", "f", "r"))
sliderInput("displ", "Engine size", min = 1.6, max = 7, value = c(1.6, 7), step = 0.1)
```

## Column

```{r}
#| title: Engine size and highway mpg
plotlyOutput("p1")
```

```{r}
#| title: Count
plotlyOutput("p2")
```

# Data

```{r}
#| title: Cars
DTOutput("tbl")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
filtered <- reactive({
  df |> filter(drv %in% input$drv, displ >= input$displ[1], displ <= input$displ[2])
})
output$p1 <- renderPlotly({
  if (nrow(filtered()) == 0) return(empty_plot())
  ggplotly(ggplot(filtered(), aes(displ, hwy, color = .data[[input$var]])) + geom_point())
})
output$p2 <- renderPlotly({
  if (nrow(filtered()) == 0) return(empty_plot())
  ggplotly(ggplot(filtered(), aes(.data[[input$var]])) + geom_bar())
})
output$tbl <- renderDT(datatable(filtered()))
```
